attribution.method: Separate source-import subprocesses; generated temporary Stores; startup/source preparation and one warm derivation outside profile; one cProfile derivation per arm/size; full stored summary/Activity/error-reference/Findings hashes with no excluded fields.

conclusions: Existing metadata-only index cannot certify equal canonical detail, supersession window or raw-record coverage.
Hydration reconstructs Activity; it does not avoid evidence_detail sanitization.
Lazy Findings owner construction was not pursued: about6% instrumented attribution plus malformed-input exception risk.
No new retained content, cache, schema, migration or runtime behavior was implemented.

required_proofs: exact source version and selected window

unimplemented_options.option: Versioned canonical projection preserving existing bounds

import cProfile,hashlib,json,pathlib,pstats,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.benchmark_http_tails import payload,TRACE
from observatory.core import Store,normalize_native
selected={'derive_trace','analyze','source_owner','credentials','_credential_hits','_activity_for','_activity_row','_tool_activity','evidence_detail','safe_value','_recorded_activity_agents','_review_owner','summarize','_agent_id_from_attributes','_agent_node_from_attributes','full','operation_facts','canonical_terminal','normalized_evidence'}
rows=[]
for writes in (140,280):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='agenturm-success-attribution-')as directory:
  store=Store(pathlib.Path(directory)/'generated.db')
  try:
   with store._connect()as db:db.execute("UPDATE schema_meta SET value=? WHERE key='receiver_id'",('f'*32,))
   latest={}
   for sequence in range(writes):
    body=payload(sequence,1_800_000_000_000_000_000)
    for span in body['spans']:latest[span['span_id']]=normalize_native(span,body['service'])
   store.ingest(list(latest.values()));store._refresh_summaries([TRACE])
   profile=cProfile.Profile();profile.enable();store._refresh_summaries([TRACE]);profile.disable()
   stats=pstats.Stats(profile)
   functions=[]
   for (filename,line,name),(primitive,total,own,cumulative,callers)in stats.stats.items():
    if name not in selected:continue
    functions.append(dict(file=pathlib.Path(filename).name,line=line,name=name,primitive=primitive,total=total,own_seconds=own,cumulative_seconds=cumulative,
      callers=[dict(file=pathlib.Path(key[0]).name,name=key[2],calls=value[0]if isinstance(value,tuple)else value,
        cumulative_seconds=value[3]if isinstance(value,tuple)and len(value)>3 else None)for key,value in callers.items()]))
   with store._read()as db:
    summary=db.execute('SELECT summary_json,activity_json,error_refs_json FROM trace_summaries WHERE trace_id=?',(TRACE,)).fetchone()
    findings=[row[0]for row in db.execute('SELECT finding_json FROM finding_cache WHERE trace_id=? ORDER BY finding_id',(TRACE,))]
   serial=json.dumps(dict(summary=json.loads(summary[0]),activity=json.loads(summary[1]),refs=json.loads(summary[2]),findings=[json.loads(item)for item in findings]),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
   rows.append(dict(writes=writes,source_spans=len(latest),canonical_activity=len(json.loads(summary[1])),refs=len(json.loads(summary[2])),
    stored_projection_sha256=hashlib.sha256(serial.encode()).hexdigest(),instrumented_total_seconds=stats.total_tt,functions=functions))
  finally:store.close()
print(json.dumps(dict(root=str(root),commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),generated_only=True,diagnostic_only=True,publishable=False,profiles=rows),indent=2))

from unittest.mock import patch

report=dict(generated_only=True,diagnostic_only=True,publishable=False,cases={})
def state(store,trace):
 with store._read()as db:
  activity=json.loads(db.execute('SELECT activity_json FROM trace_summaries WHERE trace_id=?',(trace,)).fetchone()[0])
  indexed=[json.loads(r[0])for r in db.execute('SELECT payload FROM activity_index_v1 WHERE trace_id=? ORDER BY event_key',(trace,))]
  return activity,indexed,dict(activity_dirty=db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_dirty_v1').fetchone()[0],v15=bool(db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM schema_meta WHERE key='trace_derived_v15' AND value='1'").fetchone()))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='agenturm-activity-reuse-proof-')as directory:
 store=Store(pathlib.Path(directory)/'generated.db')
 try:
  body=payload(0,1800000000000000000);records=[normalize_native(x,body['service'])for x in body['spans']];store.ingest(records)
  before,ib,proof=state(store,TRACE)
  records[1]['attributes']['input.value']={'query':'changed-generated-input'};records[1]['attributes']['output.value']={'count':999};store.ingest([records[1]])
  after,ia,proof=state(store,TRACE)

   hydrated=hydrate(db,[dict(x)for x in ia]);hydrate_calls=full.call_count
  report['cases']['immutable-index-metadata-cannot-certify-full-body']=dict(index_payload_equal=ib==ia,canonical_activity_equal=before==after,

  trace='b'*32;span='1'*16;owner={'agent.id':'fixture-worker','session.id':'fixture-session'}

  logs=[dict(trace_id=trace,span_id=span,time_unix_nano=2,service='fixture',event_name='agent.activity',body='Generated finished operation',severity_number=9,severity_text='INFO',scope_name='fixture',resource_attributes={},attributes={**owner,'agent.activity.domain':'tool','agent.activity.action':'call','agent.activity.subject':'Bash','agent.activity.result':'success'})]
  logs.extend(dict(trace_id=trace,span_id=None,time_unix_nano=n+3,service='fixture',event_name='generated.noise',body='Generated non-Activity log',severity_number=9,severity_text='INFO',scope_name='fixture',resource_attributes={},attributes=owner)for n in range(256))

  trace='c'*32

  activity,indexed,proof=state(store,trace)
